# telnyx_enterprises (Data Source)

Lists enterprises, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_enterprise`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_legal_name_contains` (String)
- `filter_role_type` (String) One of `bpo`, `enterprise`.
- `legal_name` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `enterprises` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprises))

<a id="nestedatt--enterprises"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprises`

Read-Only:

- `billing_address` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprises--billing_address))
- `billing_contact` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprises--billing_contact))
- `bpo_verification_rejection_reason` (String) Reason Telnyx rejected the BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) verification, when `bpo_verification_status` is `rejected`; `null` otherwise.
- `bpo_verification_status` (String) Whether Telnyx has approved this BPO (Business Process Outsourcer) account. Only set for accounts created with `role_type` `bpo`; `null` for normal enterprises. A BPO enterprise must be `approved` before a DIR can be linked to it through `bpo_authorizations`.
- `branded_calling_enabled` (Boolean) True once Branded Calling has been activated on this enterprise (see `POST /enterprises/{id}/branded_calling`).
- `corporate_registration_number` (String) The official number your company received when it was legally registered or incorporated (for example from your state or national business registry). It is on your certificate of incorporation.
- `country_code` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `customer_reference` (String) Your own label for this account. Enter any reference that helps you find it in your records. Telnyx does not use it during vetting.
- `doing_business_as` (String) The trade name your business operates under if it is different from your legal name, also called a Doing Business As (DBA) name. Leave blank if you only use your legal name.
- `dun_bradstreet_number` (String) Your optional 9-digit D-U-N-S Number issued by Dun & Bradstreet, a unique identifier for your business. Leave blank if you do not have one.
- `fein` (String) US Federal Employer Identification Number (`NN-NNNNNNN`) or Canadian equivalent.
- `id` (String)
- `industry` (String) The industry your business operates in. Choose the closest match from the list; if your value is not accepted, pick the nearest category.
- `jurisdiction_of_incorporation` (String) The state, province, or country where your business was legally incorporated, for example Delaware.
- `legal_name` (String) Your business's full registered legal name, exactly as it appears on your incorporation or tax documents, 3 to 64 characters.
- `number_of_employees` (String) Approximate headcount range. Used for vetting heuristics; pick the bucket that contains your current employee count.
- `number_reputation_enabled` (Boolean) True once Phone Number Reputation has been enabled on this enterprise (see `POST /enterprises/{id}/reputation`).
- `organization_contact` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprises--organization_contact))
- `organization_legal_type` (String) Legal-entity form. Pick the form that matches your incorporation documents: - `corporation` - C-corp or S-corp. - `llc` - limited liability company. - `partnership` - general/limited partnership. - `nonprofit` - non-profit corporation, charitable trust, or 501(c)(3)/equivalent. - `other` - anything else (sole proprietorships, government bodies, DBAs, etc.). You may be asked for additional documents during vetting.
- `organization_physical_address` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprises--organization_physical_address))
- `organization_type` (String)
- `primary_business_domain_sic_code` (String) The 4-digit Standard Industrial Classification code for your main line of business, which tells us what industry you operate in. Look it up in the SIC code directory if you are unsure.
- `professional_license_number` (String) If your business operates under a professional license (for example legal, medical, or financial services), enter the license number issued by the licensing authority. Leave blank if it does not apply.
- `role_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `website` (String) Your business's public website address, including https://. Leave blank if your business has no website.

<a id="nestedatt--enterprises--billing_address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprises.billing_address`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) State or province code (e.g. `IL`, `ON`).
- `city` (String) The city of your registered business address.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (currently `US` or `CA`).
- `extended_address` (String) An optional second address line, such as a suite, unit, or floor. Leave blank if it does not apply.
- `postal_code` (String) The postal or ZIP code of your registered business address.
- `street_address` (String) The street address of your registered business, including the building number and street name.


<a id="nestedatt--enterprises--billing_contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprises.billing_contact`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address of the person Telnyx should contact about billing for this account.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the person Telnyx should contact about billing for this account.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the person Telnyx should contact about billing for this account.
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number of the billing contact, in E.164 format, for example +12125551234.


<a id="nestedatt--enterprises--organization_contact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprises.organization_contact`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address of the main person Telnyx should contact about this account. For a call center (BPO) account this is the email you will verify later, so use a mailbox you can access.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the main person Telnyx should contact about this account.
- `job_title` (String) The job title of the main person Telnyx should contact about this account.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the main person Telnyx should contact about this account.
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number of the main contact, in E.164 format, for example +12125551234.

### Nested Schema for `enterprises.organization_physical_address`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) State or province code (e.g. `IL`, `ON`).
- `city` (String) The city of your registered business address.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (currently `US` or `CA`).
- `extended_address` (String) An optional second address line, such as a suite, unit, or floor. Leave blank if it does not apply.
- `postal_code` (String) The postal or ZIP code of your registered business address.
- `street_address` (String) The street address of your registered business, including the building number and street name.
